title: One reward per place survives losing the database
proves: Stamp ownership on Solana is the source of truth: a wallet that already holds a stamp for a place is blocked even if the server starts with an empty database.
cost: none if blocked, 0.01 RLUSD if it wrongly pays
summary: Blocked even with an empty database: once per place: this Solana wallet already holds a stamp for this place

assertions.description: a brand new server (empty database) still blocks the claim

reasons: once per place: this Solana wallet already holds a stamp for this place

evidence.note: This wallet already holds an Apollo Theater stamp from C01.
